verdict.rationale: Anytype offers official programmatic surfaces: a localhost API with a published, versioned OpenAPI spec, a gRPC API, a headless CLI for scripting, an official MCP server, and an open-source agents toolkit that runs scripts against Anytype data. The pack never names an official language SDK or client library, so developers have to build against the raw API or generate clients from the spec. Missing for 10: explicitly documented official SDK packages (e.g., JS/Python client libraries), SDK reference docs, a deprecation policy, and independent hands-on corroboration of building with them.
